engine_configuration.typhoon: Typhoon OCR, the vision-language model the product uses. Whole page in, text out; no layout stage of our own. Predictions are reused from the earlier cached run rather than re-billed.
engine_configuration.paddle: PaddleOCR full pipeline: PP-DocLayoutV3 for layout and reading order, then PP-OCRv5_server_det for line detection, then th_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec. CPU. Regions labelled table, formula, chart, figure, image or stamp are EXCLUDED before recognition, so their text is scored as deleted. Some pages kill the native process outright; those are recorded with status=crashed and an empty prediction rather than dropped from the denominator.
engine_configuration.tesseract: Tesseract LSTM, lang=tha+eng, official tessdata. Whole page, no layout stage.
